purpose: Separate existence of norm-power feature functionals from the operator remainder theorem, which receives those functionals as explicit hypotheses.

nodes.title: Norm powers as explicit feature functionals
nodes.statement_tex: For every natural $d$, $\|x\|^{2d}=\sum_{f:\operatorname{Fin}d\to\operatorname{Fin}n}(\prod_jx_{f(j)})^2$. Consequently, for all natural $n,q$, there exist continuous linear functionals $L_j$ on the degree-$2q$ feature space, indexed by $j:\operatorname{Fin}q$, with $L_j(\Phi_{2q}(x))=\|x\|^{2(j+1)}$ for every $x$.
hypotheses: n,q,d are natural numbers, including zero.
nodes.proof_sketch_tex: Expand $(\sum_i x_i^2)^d$ by the finite multinomial sum. For each $j$, duplicate every coordinate tuple of length $j+1$ into a tuple of length $2(j+1)$, sum the corresponding coordinate projections in that feature block, and divide by the strictly positive square-root weight. This constructs the functional explicitly and uses no Gaussian or analytic-projection theorem.
nodes.status_note: Exact source passed NormFeatureFunctionalCheck with only standard axioms; canonical integration awaits CI.

theorem norm_pow_eq_sum_coordinate_monomials {n : ℕ} (x : Euclidean n) (d : ℕ) :
    ‖x‖ ^ (2 * d) = ∑ f : Fin d → Fin n, (∏ j, x (f j)) ^ 2

theorem exists_normPolynomial_feature_functionals (n q : ℕ) :
    ∃ L : Fin q → PolynomialFeatureSpace n (2 * q) →L[ℝ] ℝ,
      ∀ j x, L j (polynomialFeature (2 * q) x) = ‖x‖ ^ (2 * (j.val + 1))
